slides.title: One Continuous Scientific Conversation
bullets: The HCP sits at the center of the communication strategy
Field visits, email, digital content, webinars and congresses coordinate
Each touchpoint builds on the last instead of repeating it
The HCP experiences one conversation, not scattered messages

slides.title: HCPs Already Behave Omnichannel
bullets: Scientific information consumption is increasingly fragmented
A quick mobile read between consults, a webinar at night
Deep conversations reserved for trusted, complex questions
Behavior changed first, strategy is catching up

slides.title: Coordination, Not Just More Channels
bullets: Data on interests and prior interactions is shared across channels
Content, sequence and format adapt to what is already known
The alternative is the same generic message on every channel

slides.title: Four Building Blocks Behind Real Omnichannel
bullets: A unified HCP view, usually through a shared CRM
Scientific interactions logged, not just commercial contacts
Channel planning integrated into one medical plan
Strict separation between non-promotional and commercial communication

slides.title: Omnichannel Enriches the Personal Relationship
bullets: Know what content an HCP already consumed before a visit
Anticipate the questions they may want resolved in person
Recommend digital content that extends the visit afterward
The personal relationship stays the core, not replaced

takeaway.title: Omnichannel medical coordinates every channel around one continuous HCP conversation
bullets: Success means messages build on each other, not repeat
A shared CRM and one medical plan make coordination possible
Scientific and commercial data must stay clearly separated
